data.title: 2027 Analog & Mixed-Signal Design Intern
data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.

 

AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.




As an AMD intern, you’ll be placed at the epicenter of the AI ecosystem, working alongside experts and industry pioneers. You’ll do important work, learn new skills, expand your network, and gain real-world experience on projects that impact millions of end-users worldwide. Whether you’re an undergrad or a PhD student, your contributions matter—and your experience here will be a launchpad for what comes next. 

 

An exciting internship opportunity to make an immediate contribution to AMD's next generation of technology innovations awaits you! We have a multifaceted, high-energy work environment, filled with a diverse group of employees, and we provide outstanding opportunities for developing your career. During your internship, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with AMD leaders, receive one-on-one mentorship, attend amazing networking events, and much more. Being part of AMD means receiving hands-on experience that will give you a competitive edge. Together We Advance your career!

 

JOB DETAILS:

  • Location: Cork or Dublin, Ireland 
  • Onsite: This role requires the student to work full time onsite throughout the duration of the intern term
  • Duration: Students must be available to start on January 15th (Cork or Dublin) or June 1st (Cork-only)for a 6-month internship 

ABOUT THE TEAM
The AMD SerDes team in Ireland develops high-speed SerDes solutions operating at 200+ Gb/s using advanced CMOS FinFET technologies. The team has extensive expertise in the design of analog and mixed-signal circuits for the high-speed transmission, reception, clocking, and recovery of data over wired links. The successful candidate will join a world-class engineering team developing advanced SerDes solutions that enable high-performance connectivity across AMD CPU, GPU, and FPGA products.


The Analog Mixed-Signal (AMS) team designs high-performance analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits, including ADCs, DACs, voltage and current references, clocking circuits, regulators, high-speed interfaces, and SerDes-related analog building blocks. As part of AMD's IC design team, you will work alongside experienced analog and mixed-signal designers and gain hands-on exposure to the complete IC design flow, from circuit specifications and architecture through transistor-level design, simulation, layout, verification, and post-layout analysis.
The internship is designed to provide practical experience in analog and mixed-signal IC design using industry-leading design tools, advanced CMOS technologies, and professional design methodologies.

 

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

As an Analog & Mixed-Signal Design Intern, you will work alongside experienced engineers and gain hands-on experience designing advanced integrated circuits, including high-speed SerDes.

  • Learn how system requirements are translated into analog and mixed-signal circuit designs.
  • Support the design, simulation and optimization of transistor-level circuits.
  • Work with analog building blocks such as amplifiers, bias circuits, voltage/current references, data converters, clocking circuits and high-speed interfaces.
  • Run simulations across different operating conditions and analyse key performance metrics such as gain, bandwidth, noise, power, jitter and stability.
  • Gain exposure to custom IC layout, including matching, placement, routing and parasitic effects.
  • Evaluate designs through pre-layout and post-layout simulation and verification.
  • Participate in design reviews and share your findings with experienced engineers.
  • Gain hands-on experience with industry-standard IC design and simulation tools.


WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

You are currently enrolled in university in a program majoring in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Microelectronics, Integrated Circuit Design, or a related discipline, and have an interest in analog and mixed-signal IC design.

If you have experience with any of the following technical skills (or related areas) and are enthusiastic about this role, we strongly encourage you to apply - 

  • Electronic circuit fundamentals, including MOS transistors and transistor-level circuit analysis.
  • Analog concepts such as biasing, differential amplifiers, feedback, frequency response, stability, noise and device matching.
  • Familiarity with analog/mixed-signal circuits such as ADCs, DACs, PLLs, regulators, references or high-speed interfaces.
  • Exposure to SPICE-based circuit simulation or analog IC design environments.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Cadence Virtuoso, Spectre, Synopsys Custom Compiler or HSPICE is an advantage, but not required.
  • Basic knowledge of custom IC layout or physical design.
  • Experience with Python, MATLAB, Tcl, Perl, or similar tools for data analysis or automation.
  • Analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Curiosity, initiative and an interest in developing your skills in analog/mixed-signal IC design, high-speed circuits and leading-edge CMOS technologies.

 

Note: By submitting your application, you are indicating your interest in AMD intern positions. We are recruiting for multiple positions, and if your experience aligns with any of our intern opportunities, a recruiter will contact you.




Benefits offered are described:  AMD benefits at a glance.

 

AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.   We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.

 

AMD may use Artificial Intelligence to help screen, assess or select applicants for this position.  AMD’s “Responsible AI Policy” is available here.

 

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

 

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.




As an AMD Student Engineer, you’ll be placed at the epicenter of the AI ecosystem, working alongside experts and industry pioneers. You’ll do important work, learn new skills, expand your network, and gain real-world experience on projects that impact millions of end-users worldwide. Whether you’re an undergrad or a PhD student, your contributions matter—and your experience here will be a launchpad for what comes next.

 

JOB DETAILS:

  • Location: Iasi, RO 
  • Onsite: This role requires the student to work part time onsite (20 hours per week) throughout the duration of the term 
  • Term date: From February 1, 2027 to July 31, 2027

 

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING:

Do you want to help improve the experiences of groundbreaking AMD products? If so, AMD
Hardware team is the right place for you. We are seeking a highly motivated student with a willingness to learn and absorb new concepts and technologies, along with a sound understanding of x86-64 computer architecture.

 

  • You will be developing key skills that are relevant to the semiconductor industry in X86 Cores Design Verification. 
  • You will be given guidance on what to do, and the freedom to plan and manage your own time to deliver upon agreed goals.
  • Your progress will be regularly reviewed, and constructive feedback given to help you make the best use of your time.
  • Your tasks will include documentation, coding, debugging 

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

  • You are currently enrolled in a Romanian-based university Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or related discipline
  • If you have knowledge / experience with any of the following technical skills (or
    related areas) and are enthusiastic about this role, we strongly encourage you to
    apply 
    • Exposure to CPU computer architectures 
    • Familiarity with basic programming, data structures and algorithms 
    • Exposure to OOP languages (C++ / System Verilog / etc.) 
    • Exposure to Scripting languages (Perl / Python) 
    • Exposure to Digital Design (VHDL / Verilog) 
    • Good understanding of the faculty courses that are relevant for software development and digital design and verification.
    • Passion for modern, complex processor architectures and digital design.
    • Good written and verbal English 

 

Note: By submitting your application, you are indicating your interest in AMD Student Engineer positions. We are recruiting for multiple positions, and if your experience aligns with any of our Student Engineer opportunities, a recruiter will contact you.

JOB DETAILS:

Location: Markham, Ontario, Canada

Onsite: This role requires the student to work full time (37.5 hours a week), in an onsite work structure throughout the duration of the co-op term.

Winter Duration:

  • 4 Months: January 11, 2027 to April 23, 2027
  • 8 Months: January 11, 2027 to August 20, 2027

Summer Duration:

  • 4 Months: May 3, 2027 to August 20, 2027
  • 8 Months: May 3, 2027 to December 10, 2027

Fall Duration:

  • 4 Months: September 13, 2027 to December 10, 2027

 

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING:

  • Support graphics product management, product marketing, sales and PR by testing, analyzing and documenting 3D performance and other key features of graphics products.
  • Measure and report on the performance of the entire AMD Radeon graphics product line, plus relevant competitors, using industry standard benchmarks, 3D games, and other relevant tests.
  • Measure, analyze and track the performance changes that arise in each new Radeon display driver. Characterize performance changes in terms of which products are most strongly affected, which resolutions, which framebuffer sizes, and similar. Generate summary points to be presented in the driver release notes and other outlets.
  • Measure the performance, features and quality of upcoming graphics products, comparing them to existing and competitor products. Use games, synthetic benchmarks, diagnostic tests and utilities as appropriate. Analyze results and report strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats. Analyze new competitor products in a similar fashion.
  • Contribute to reviewers' guides that highlight the performance and features of upcoming graphics products. Depict performance data in charts and graphs, document “how to test” steps and other relevant materials.
  • Monitor and report on trends in review techniques (titles used, resolutions, image quality settings, etc.). Track release schedules for new games and benchmarks. Incorporate new titles into the test flow in a timely manner.
  • Analyze new test applications and games for system and graphics sensitivities. Prepare and present reports that highlight the performance of key Radeon and competitor graphics products in the new title.
  • Write scripts and related tools to build command lines and configuration files that automate performance testing. Generate code that launches test applications at various settings, traps error conditions and takes remedial actions, parses result files, installs helper apps, etc.
  • Prepare images of current Windows operating systems to be deployed across numerous test machines. Use Microsoft sysprep and DISM tools. Update the OS images as required to keep pace with service packs and other updates.

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

University Degree Program in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a similar related discipline is strongly preferred. Marketing, Business Administration, Commerce and similar programs that include a rigorous IS, IT or CompSci component may also be considered.

  • Strong knowledge of computer graphics and video technology
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills; strong teamwork and interpersonal skills
  • Action oriented with strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Experience with PC assembly and hardware upgrades, hardware and software troubleshooting
  • Experience installing and configuring Microsoft operating systems and applications
  • Familiarity with semiconductor and PC industry standards
  • Ability to multitask effectively in a fast paced environment
  • Experience with C++, Python, XML, HTML, Excel, databases would be an asset.

Candidates must hold a valid work authorization to be considered for this role.

data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

 

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.




As an AMD [intern/co-op], you’ll be placed at the epicenter of the AI ecosystem, working alongside experts and industry pioneers. You’ll do important work, learn new skills, expand your network, and gain real-world experience on projects that impact millions of end-users worldwide. Whether you’re an undergrad or a PhD student, your contributions matter—and your experience here will be a launchpad for what comes next.

 

JOB TITLE: 2027 Term 1 Internship – Advanced Packaging Optical Characterization

LOCATION: Singapore

ONSITE/HYBRID REQUIREMENT: This role requires the student to work full time (40 hours a week), in either a hybrid or onsite work structure throughout the duration of the co-op/intern term.

CRITERIA: Current students studying in universities based in Singapore and able to provide a placement/support letter from their school covering the entire internship period.

INTERNSHIP DURATION: Term 1 Internship Start Date: 4 Jan 2027, End Date: 28 May 2027 or 6 Aug 2027.

 

 

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT TO LEARN:

 

  • Hands-on experience with optical and laser measurement equipment used to characterize electro-optical devices and IC packaging-related optical links. 
  • Practical understanding of optical power, insertion loss, return loss, polarization extinction ratio, wavelength, attenuation, switching, and thermal-stability measurements. 
  • Experience developing repeatable measurement methods, basic instrument automation, data analysis, uncertainty checks, and technical documentation. 
  • Exposure to laboratory bring-up activities such as equipment checkout, safety practices, calibration checks, fixture readiness, troubleshooting, and collaboration with vendors and engineers. 
  • Opportunity to convert experimental results into clear plots, test reports, standard work instructions, and recommendations that support future lab users. 

 

 

PROJECT OVERVIEW:

 

The Singapore Optics Lab is bringing up a new set of optics and laser characterization tools. The intern will work with the lab team to qualify selected instruments and accessories, establish baseline test methods, and create repeatable workflows for optical component and electro-optical device characterization. The average day may include equipment setup, sample or reference-device preparation, measurement execution, data review, script development, troubleshooting, and documentation. The project will emphasize safe laboratory practices, traceable results, and methods that can be transferred to future users. 

By the end of the term, the intern is expected to deliver a characterized subset of the laboratory toolchain, validated measurement workflows, reusable data-analysis or automation scripts where practical, and a concise technical report summarizing performance, limitations, and recommended next steps. 

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

 

  • Develop measurement workflows for optical power, attenuation, wavelength, insertion loss and return loss, polarization extinction ratio, switching paths, thermal cycling, and electro-optical response, as applicable to the assigned tools. 
  • Analyse results with suitable plots and basic statistical checks; identify measurement variation, setup sensitivity, and tool or method limitations.
  • Automate data capture and analysis using Python, MATLAB, LabVIEW, or vendor software when practical; maintain clear version-controlled scripts and test records. 

 

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR:

 

  • Careful and methodical when handling electro-optical devices and laboratory equipment. 
  • Able to troubleshoot systematically, document observations clearly, and seek guidance when operating limits or safety requirements are unclear. 
  • Comfortable working collaboratively with engineers, laboratory users, and equipment vendors. 
  • Good written and verbal communication, with attention to data integrity and laboratory discipline. 

 

RELEVANT SKILLSETS:

 

  • Basic electrical/electronic laboratory skills, including oscilloscopes, power supplies, signal integrity awareness, and safe equipment setup. 
  • Fundamental knowledge of optics or photonics.
  • Programming or data analysis using Python, MATLAB, LabVIEW, or similar tools; ability to process CSV files and generate clear engineering plots. 
  • Useful but not mandatory: familiarity with semiconductor packaging, electro-optical testing, thermal control, and instrument control interfaces.

 

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Photonics, Optics, or a related field.

You’ll do important work, learn new skills, expand your network, and gain real-world experience on projects that impact millions of end-users worldwide. Whether you’re an undergrad or a PhD student, your contributions matter—and your experience here will be a launchpad for what comes next.

 

JOB DETAILS:

Location: Markham, Ontario, Canada

Onsite/Hybrid: This role requires the student to work full time 37.5 hrs a week, in a onsite work structure throughout the duration of the co-op/intern term.

Winter Duration:

  • 4 Months: January 11, 2027 to April 23, 2027
  • 8 Months: January 11, 2027 to August 20, 2027

Summer Duration:

  • 4 Months: May 3, 2027 to August 20, 2027
  • 8 Months: May 3, 2027 to December 10, 2027

Fall Duration:

  • 4 Months: September 13, 2027 to December 10, 2027

 

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING:

We are seeking a highly motivated Hardware Design Verification Engineering intern/co-op to join our team and support the testing and verification of AMD’s high-end Machine Intelligence products. In this role you will participate in one or more of (but not limited to) the below assignments –

  • Collaborate with senior engineers and/or designers to build and complete performance verification test plan, simulation test cases and models
  • Write scripts related to tracking and managing resources using Perl/Python
  • We will assign tasks related to test regression flows written in Perl/Python/MySQL/PHP to support our project development
  • You will review new tools, processes and options to improve simulation performance, team efficiency and reduction of duplications
  • Support debugging, improving simulation test cases/models and Verilog/system Verilog coding
  • Build test platforms and perform system level testing
  • Production validation tasks, testing the integrated hardware and software functionalities to ensure problem-free production

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

  • Currently enrolled in a Canada based University into a Bachelor's degree program majoring in Electrical engineering, Computer science, Computer engineering or a related field. 
  • If you have experience with any of the following technical skills (or related areas) and are enthusiastic about this role, we strongly encourage you to apply –
    • Programming languages and scripts such as C++ /Python /C /Perl /Shell / UVM
    • Verilog and System Verilog
    • Good understanding of the digital systems and computer organization
    • Building a PC from individual components, installing OS/drivers, basic network configuration, graphic cards
    • CPU/APU
    • System level hardware and software design
    • Development and debugging in Linux / Unix / Windows environments
    • Fundamentals of logic design (FSM, gates, registers, flops, timing, HDL)
    • An understanding of analog and digital transistor device behavior

Note: By submitting your application, you are indicating your interest in AMD intern positions. We are recruiting for multiple positions, and if your experience aligns with any of our intern opportunities, a recruiter will contact you.

 

Candidates must hold a valid work authorization to be considered for this role.

  • 12 Months: May 03, 2027 to April 21, 2028
  • 16 Months: May 03, 2027 to August 18, 2028

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING:

 

You will join our team of experts developing ASIC and Adaptive SoC intellectual property (IP) for the next generation communication networks and data centers. You’ll work with a highly motivated team of engineers developing advanced verification environments for best-in-class configurable silicon targeted for wired communication applications.

  • Contribute to the development of advanced SystemVerilog-UVM based verification environments and IP components
  • Write tests, sequences, and testbench components in SystemVerilog and UVM to achieve verification of the design
  • Learn to employ a Coverage-Driven Verification methodology with Constrained Random Stimulus
  • Review and contribute to verification plans and design specifications
  • Contribute to process improvements via automation of tasks and exploring and evaluating new tools and methodologies
  • Investigate and root cause issues found during the IP development stage

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

  • 3rd/4th year Computer Engineering or Computer Science students with:
  • Understanding of digital design principles
  • Understanding of Object Oriented Coding practices
  • Experience with AI tools 
  • Experience with Systemverilog, C or C++ programming languages
  • Experience with Python, Perl or other scripting languages is an asset

Candidates must hold a valid work authorization to be considered for this role.

data.title: Short Term 2027 Software Engineering Intern/Co-Op
data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

 

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

As an AMD intern, you’ll be placed at the epicenter of the AI ecosystem, working alongside experts and industry pioneers. You’ll do important work, learn new skills, expand your network, and gain real-world experience on projects that impact millions of end-users worldwide. Whether you’re an undergrad or a PhD student, your contributions matter—and your experience here will be a launchpad for what comes next.

 

JOB DETAILS:

Location: Markham, Ontario, Canada

Onsite/Hybrid: This role requires the student to work full time 37.5 hrs a week, in a onsite work structure throughout the duration of the co-op/intern term. 

Winter Duration:

  • 4 Months: January 11, 2027 to April 23, 2027
  • 8 Months: January 11, 2027 to August 20, 2027

Summer Duration:

  • 4 Months: May 3, 2027 to August 20, 2027
  • 8 Months: May 3, 2027 to December 10, 2027

Fall Duration:

  • 4 Months: September 13, 2027 to December 10, 2027

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING: 

We are seeking a highly motivated Software Engineering intern/co-op to join our team at AMD. In this role –  

 We will assign you responsibilities in which you will work closely with our software engineers to build and maintain our software applications 

  • We will provide training on the full software creation process, from design and build to testing and deployment 
  • We will encourage you to build scripts that automate some of our software development process 
  • We will help you learn debugging methodologies to investigate the root cause of software issues  
  • In certain projects we may have your involvement in crafting technical/functional documents and reports as needed 

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

  • You are currently enrolled in a Canada based University into a Bachelor's degree program majoring in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or related discipline 
  • If you have knowledge / experience with any of the following technical skills (or related areas) and are enthusiastic about this role, we strongly encourage you to apply – 
    • Software engineering concepts, principles, and theories  
    • C/C++ programming and Scripting language like Python, Windows PowerShell, Linux shell script, Perl, Java, Javascript, UML 
    • Operating systems UNIX/Linux OS  
    • Databases, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB 
    • Cloud computing platforms, Azure 
    • Web development frameworks, Django, Rails, Spring Boot 
    • Mark up languages like HTML, XML, XSL 
    • Defect tracking, testing, debugging 
    • Git, Github, Perforce 
    • Security technologies, OAuth, SSL, or TLS 
    • PC / CPU architecture, Embedded systems, microcontrollers 

 

 

Note: By submitting your application, you are indicating your interest in AMD intern positions. We are recruiting for multiple positions, and if your experience aligns with any of our intern opportunities, a recruiter will contact you

 

Candidates must hold a valid work authorization to be considered for this role.

Benefits offered are described:  AMD benefits at a glance.

 

AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.   We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.

 

AMD may use Artificial Intelligence to help screen, assess or select applicants for this position.  AMD’s “Responsible AI Policy” is available here.

 

This posting is for an existing vacancy.
